assumptions.statement: SITE-001 and the three key-area polygons are provisional rough work geometry, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All design geometry, areas, ratios and drawings require full regeneration after official polygons are issued.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, density, setbacks, road controls, parking and public-facility quotas are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: No statutory intensity, height, setback, demolition or engineering claim is made.

assumptions.statement: Existing buildings, condition, ownership, tenancy, utilities and fire constraints are not available as cleared GIS.
assumptions.impact: Building footprints are program placeholders; survey-first adaptive reuse is the only stated direction.

assumptions.statement: No verified local maintenance baseline, asset register, failure taxonomy or service-level agreement is available.
assumptions.impact: Operational KPIs are defined as formulas and gates, not fabricated baselines or targets.

assumptions.statement: Maintenance sensing must avoid face, voice, emotion and individual movement tracking by default.
assumptions.impact: Use minimum asset and event data, role-based access, short retention, human verification and non-digital reporting.

assumptions.statement: Repair access, warranties, parts, software locks, cyber security and product liability vary by asset.
assumptions.impact: No device is opened, modified or connected without authority, isolation and qualified human supervision.

assumptions.statement: Railway heritage, monuments, ecology, water and tree protection controls are not available as official polygons.
assumptions.impact: Landmarks and maintenance demonstrations remain reversible and outside any unverified protected fabric.

assumptions.statement: Named operators, partners, budgets, procurement and implementation dates are not confirmed.
assumptions.impact: All partners, events and implementation roles are conceptual proposals for professional and public co-design.
